meta.name: treasury-and-liquidity
meta.description: Manages cash and liquidity — cash forecasting, runway, working capital, banking structure, and currency and counterparty exposure. Use this to build a cash forecast, extend runway, improve working capital, decide where cash should sit, or assess exposure to a bank, currency, or customer concentration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测现金流，优化营运资金，保障资金安全。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责企业资金管理，需要做现金规划和风险评估。
copy.tagline_en: Plan cash flows, optimize working capital, and manage liquidity risk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage corporate treasury and need to plan cash flows and control liquidity risk.

howto.what: 装上后，模型会按该技能管理现金与流动性：用直接法做按周收付款预测、滚动13周对比实际，评估情景化跑道，改善营运资本，并评估现金存放和对手方集中风险。
howto.when: 当用户要求建立现金预测、延长现金跑道或改善营运资本等与现金流动性相关的事项时触发。

say.text: 帮我把未来13周的现金收支按周预测出来。
say.note: 模型会生成按周的直接法收付款预测。

say.text: 我们的现金跑道能撑多久？做一下下行情景分析。
say.note: 计算计划、下行及大额应收延迟情景下的跑道。

say.text: 现金放在哪家银行合适？帮我评估集中度风险。
say.note: 会评估银行/货币/客户集中度并给出放置建议。

howto.what_en: Once installed, the model builds weekly cash receipt/payment forecasts, compares 13-week rolling forecasts to actuals, evaluates scenario-based runway, improves working capital, and flags cash placement and counterparty exposure risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build a cash forecast, extend runway, improve working capital, or otherwise requests cash and liquidity management.

say_en.text: Help me forecast cash inflows and outflows for the next 13 weeks, week by week.
say_en.note: Creates weekly direct-method cash flow forecast.

say_en.text: How long is our cash runway? Run a downside scenario analysis.
say_en.note: Shows plan, downside, and delayed-receivable runway.

say_en.text: Where should we hold our cash? Assess concentration risk.
say_en.note: Flags bank/currency/customer exposure and where to put cash.
